# ARCH-10: Nothing from outside is trusted

- Bound every loop and buffer, check every index and length before use, validate values from parameters, sensors and the wire, and treat an impossible state as an internal error rather than a crash. Never index an array from a user-set parameter (peterbarker, [#26887](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/26887)).

Confirmed 2026-10-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
